name: GFC. LTD.
summary: GFC. LTD., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells elevators, escalators, and generators in Taiwan. It offers escalators/moving walks and pneumatic vacuum elevators. The company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of elevators and parts; sale of vacuum pneumatic shuttle elevators; construction and maintenance and power generation products. The company was formerly known as Golden Friends Corporation and changed its name to GFC. LTD. in August 2021. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. GFC. LTD. operates as a subsidiary of Changjiang Property Co., Ltd.
